description: Land Title Settlement Department - Diwlonkadawala, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No.120040
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determination of land titles for multiple parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels with their ownership status, extents, and classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
